answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the spiral is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the nadir of a task receipt, and the pigment is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
